text:
jamie: FYI customer hit onboarding snag with Bun/Deno sample: import fails then auth refresh triggers duplicate requests. anyone know the known gotchas?
rachel: Bun will error if package.json exports don't include an ESM entry it expects. Deno wants URL or single-file ESM.
jamie: stack: 'Error: Cannot find module "redwood-inference"' in bun, and when forcing /dist/esm/index.mjs the token refresh path caused a retry without the Authorization header.
tom: looks like two issues: packaging/exports and retry code that replays request without preserving headers/body. We assumed Request.clone() everywhere, which is false in Bun/Deno.achel: proposed fixes: 1) add dedicated deno/bun entrypoints in package.json exports (e.g., ./deno -> ./dist/deno.mjs), 2) implement normalizeRequest util that converts any input into {url, init} with Headers instance and buffered body so retries reattach auth.
alesha: typings too: add types/deno.d.ts and ensure ESM typings export defaults correctly; docs: quickstart Deno/Bun section with explicit import examples and minimal polyfills.
jamie: I'll open PRs: sample patch + docs update; assign @tom for retry code and @rachel for package.json. SDK-CI: sample-deno job failed at https://ci.internal/4972.tom: will add tests running bun/deno docker images for the sample to prevent regressions.
